videos.title: Understanding the Dispute Process
videos.surface: Amex dispute process explainer (points to the Amex Merchant website)

moments.screen: Framing: disputes can seem complicated, and Amex will make the process clearer
Amex first works directly with the Card Member, often clearing the dispute without contacting the merchant
First contact path: an inquiry, answered by the reply-by date in the notification
Inquiry outcomes: sufficient reply on time means no chargeback, otherwise the account is debited
Second path: an upfront or immediate chargeback, with a deadline to send information to reverse it
Call to action: visit the merchant website to learn about handling and preventing disputes

steps: Amex works with the Card Member to resolve the dispute
If unresolved, Amex sends an inquiry or an upfront chargeback
For an inquiry, reply with the requested information by the stated date
For an upfront chargeback, send information by the stated date to seek a reversal
Visit the merchant website to learn about handling and preventing disputes

videos.title: A Step-By-Step Overview Of The Disputes Process | American Express
videos.surface: Amex dispute process explainer (Canada, for merchants served through a merchant services provider)

moments.screen: Framing: disputes can seem complicated, and Amex will make the process clear
Amex first works with the Card Member, often without contacting the merchant
Inquiry: the merchant services provider asks for help within its own time frame
Inquiry outcomes: sufficient reply on time means no chargeback, otherwise the account is debited
Upfront chargeback: merchant sends information to its merchant services provider to seek a reversal
Call to action: visit the Amex Merchant website to help stop disputes before they start
